::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Publicly listed (BSE/NSE) semiconductor design company. One of the few Indian fabless firms with a long operating history.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Custom ASICs, SoC designs for IoT connectivity, and turnkey VLSI design services.
